text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Once again, someone crosses the finish line right before my eyes...
...I'm sick and tired of seeing it."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm not running
just to see a sight like that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's to win, and to prove it...
That I am... strong...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: As long as you hold onto those feelings, you'll be fine.
As long as you hold onto those feelings, you'll be fine.
Then this is no time to be looking around
In that case, you don't have time to look around.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't cling to words like that.
And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The desire to win is certainly there.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Next time, I'll be the one crossing the finish line in first.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: For that very reason, I will keep running.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You really know where it hurts...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You are right.
The only thing these eyes need to reflect is victory.
